crs.title: Nothing protects the engines.vscode ^1.95.0 minimum: the lock file resolves @types/vscode to 1.140.0, so a change could use a newer API without any check failing. Add a just check step that type-checks src/ against @types/vscode 1.95. Found by the cursor-compatibility spec-writer, 2026-11-14.

Stress flake: the incoming-changes scenario timed out once in frame.waitForFunction (30 s) in round 2 of a scoped stress run on CR-328's branch (PR #402). The step was not touched by that CR. Seen once; find the run, the condition it waited for, and whether it repeats.
Remove the Studio repository's remaining references to `.agents/changes/`, now that its change requests live in the planning surface. One PR, draft until CI is green; the owner merges by rebase.

On Windows, the unit test "Auto measures a table again on a real resize while a cell is edited" (test/page/tableBreakout.test.ts:398) fails, also on origin/main 16105e0f (3 of 3 runs on a fresh install), so `just preflight`'s Windows static stage is red for every change. Found by CR-336's debugger in batch-05 (diagnosis in the planning folder: 4-batch/2-actives/336-check-against-minimum-vscode-types/work/diagnosis.md). Cause undetermined; looks like a Playwright/Chromium layout difference on Windows. Find the cause and fix it so the test passes on Windows and Linux. The owner asked for the fix on 2026-11-17 (« 1. oui fix »); it is the follow-up that runs the long gate after CR-336's waiver.
